services.name: Field trips
services.desc: Free shuttle buses & parking at marked lot along Routes 5 & 10 at Yankee Candle Corporate Headquarters at 16 Yankee Candle Way. Masks are suggested on buses and indoors. Masks will be provided. Sign up at the entrance gates for a chance to win shopping certificates & free passes to the November 7 & 8, 2026 Holiday Craft Fair, gas cards or Dunkin’ Donut gift cards. The Old Deerfield Craft Fairs are organized by the Pocumtuck Valley Memorial Association, which operates Memorial Hall Museum, Indian House Children’s Museum, PVMA Library, and the Deerfield Teachers’ Center in Deerfield, MA.
